verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax docs show a taxability_reason field returned on zero-tax calculations, indicating the API can surface why a transaction wasn't taxed, but there's no evidence of an explicit customer/transaction exemption flag settable via API, nor of that exemption reason flowing through itemized reports or the TaxJar-filed return. missing for 10: explicit exemption/certificate-setting API parameter, exemption reason propagation into reports, and confirmation it appears on filed returns.
